issues.location: lambda term offered for the zero initial function
issues.finding: The frozen proof identifies the primitive-recursive zero function with the Church numeral zero, a term that takes no initial-function input. The same frozen corpus explicitly defines Zero(x)=0, so the claimed lambda definition must accept and ignore one argument before returning the zero numeral.
issues.proposed_resolution: Give the target unary zero-function term one ignored input binder, \lambd[u][\lambd[x][\lambd[y][y]]], retaining the Church zero numeral as its result.
